config.reward: visible score difference only, constant scale for optimizer
config.policy: fresh grouped physical-key-duration categorical PPO, sampled
config.resume_semantics: optimizer and policy RNG restored; emulator episodes restart from boot
config.actor_update: semi-Markov score GAE at complete option starts; every base action trains the critic
config.duration_reset: visible life loss or episode boundary; pending hold cancelled
config.grouped_duration_semantics: twenty raw logits per hold, nine fire aliases grouped to one Space; twelve distinct original keyboard commands per hold
config.grouped_duration_initialization: direction-neutral physical key mass for each supplied hold length; random encoder and actor; no source policy
config.duration_exploration: training option starts: (1-mix)*joint actor + mix*actor key marginal/uniform duration; PPO ratios use exact mixture

policy: learned grouped physical-key-duration options, sampled; holds end at visible life boundaries
